Tipp auf eine Überschrift klappt sie auf: Tap a heading to open it. You can always find this guide via the 📖 Guide button at the very bottom of the card.
Die große Zahl oben ist das Geld, das du:
The big number at the top is the money you can really still spend this month:
Account balance − fixed costs not yet checked off − expenses not yet debited.
Green = in the plus · Red = in the minus. The warning limit (⚙️ → “Calculation & warning”, where you can also switch it off) only switches the warning sensor for automations.
Tippe auf die Kachel <b>„Konto“</b> und: Tap the “Account” tile and enter the balance from your banking app. A page of its own opens, like in the shopping list. The date on the tile shows when you last entered it.
Deine Fixkosten stehen in Gruppen wie <b:
Your fixed costs are sorted into groups like “from the 1st” and “from the 15th”. The groups are collapsed: tap the heading to open one. Next time everything is closed again (only the expenses stay open). On the right you see “2 / 4” and what is still open.
Has an item been debited from your account? Tap the circle ✅. At the start of the month the checks reset by themselves (switch in ⚙️ → “Calculation & warning”).
If an item has a fixed day (e.g. on the 5th), a hint about the next debit shows at the top. Paused items (⏸️) stay in the list, grey and checked, and don’t count.
Etwas bezahlt (Karte, PayPal, bar …), da:
Paid for something (card, PayPal, cash …) that isn’t debited from your account yet? Tap a quick button (e.g. “Bakery”) or type it yourself, add the amount, ＋. The amount is subtracted from “Available” right away.
Once it shows up on your account: tap the green check ✓ (long press shows what a button does). Then it’s part of the balance and leaves the calculation. Typo? Tap the entry = change name and amount. You set the quick buttons in ⚙️ → “Quick buttons” (one per line).
Oben auf 🧮 tippen. Rechnet mit + − × ÷ u:
Tap 🧮 at the top. Calculates with + − × ÷ and %. V inserts “Available”.
With one tap you take the result as an expense, as the account balance, or copy it.
<b>🐷 Töpfe:</b> Was wo liegt (Sparkonto,:
🐷 Pots: What is where (savings account, cash at home, PayPal …). Tap = ➖ Take out or ➕ Put back. Below: Correct balance with the green check ✓ (e.g. after counting). Tap the name to close it again. What you take out shows in orange as “borrowed” until you put it back (partial amounts work too). Not coming back? Open the pot and tap the orange note → gone. “Total” = Available + all pots (so already without open fixed costs and expenses).
🧾 Open debts: What you still have to pay. Done? Tap the green check ✓. If you like, ⚙️ subtracts them from “Available”.
🏦 My accounts: Your IBANs. 📋 copies them for transfers.
💵 Income is just info and doesn’t change “Available”. Use the circle to check off whether it has arrived on your account (resets at the start of the month).
Unter <b>„Bearbeiten“</b> legst du alles:
Under “Edit” you create everything (＋ New) or tap an entry to change it. Items can be limited to certain months (e.g. car tax only in March) or paused. New groups get a start day (1–28).
Change the order: drag the handle ⠿ at the front. That way you can also move fixed costs into another group. Works for groups, pots, income, open debts and accounts too.
Am Monatsende merkt sich die Karte den M: At the end of the month the card remembers the month by itself: fixed costs, expenses, income and what was left at the end (up to 3 years). You find it in ⚙️ → Data → History.
In ⚙️ → <b>🩺 Gesundheit</b>: <b>„Alles o:
In ⚙️ → 🩺 Health: “All good?” looks for things that don’t fit together (items without a group, old balance, forgotten expenses …) and tells you how to fix them. Error log shows what couldn’t be saved. Resources shows how much space everything needs.
💣 Factory reset (⚙️ → Data, admins only): everything back to the start, only the PIN stays. Two safety questions – better “Save as CSV” first.
Das 👁️ oben verschwimmt alle Beträge und: The 👁️ at the top blurs all amounts and IBANs, e.g. when someone is watching. Tap again = show again. With privat: true in the card YAML the card starts hidden.
Wie bei mehreren Anlagen: <b>Einstellung:
Like several installations: Settings → Devices & services → Fixkosten → Add entry and give it a name (e.g. “Partner”). Every book has its own fixed costs, pots, balance, PIN and sensors.
Create a new card, pick it in the card editor under “Which book?” and under Visibility only tick the matching person. Honestly: this is order, not a safe – an HA admin can see everything.
Deine Adresse für die App steht in ⚙️ →:
The address for the app is in ⚙️ → “Offline app” (with a copy button). Open it in your phone’s browser → sign in → “Add to home screen” in the browser menu.
Without a network you see the last state. What you enter waits in the outbox (“⏳ waiting” at the top) and is sent later by itself. Nothing counts twice.
At the bottom of the app: “👆 Fingerprint lock”. When it’s on, the 🔒 lock at the top locks the whole app right away. Signing out only deletes the copy on the phone, everything stays in Home Assistant.
In ⚙️ unter <b>„Schutz (PIN)“</b> legst:
In ⚙️ under “Protection (PIN)” you set a PIN (4–8 digits). Then ⚙️ and “Edit” ask for it. Overview, checking off and expenses keep working without a PIN. The 🔓 lock below the bar (next to 🧮 and 👁️) locks again right away (otherwise after 10 minutes of inactivity). You type the PIN on the keypad like on a phone.
Forgot the PIN? No drama: an admin goes to Settings → Devices & services → Fixkosten → Configure and ticks “Reset PIN”.
In the same window you also switch “Show in sidebar” on or off.
In ⚙️ → <b>„Daten (CSV)“</b> (nur Admins: In ⚙️ → “Data (CSV)” (admins only): choose a file or paste text → “Import”. Columns: Typ;Name;Betrag;Gruppe/Datum;Zahlart;Notiz. “Save as CSV” downloads everything as a file.
Alles bleibt in <b>deinem</b> Home Assis: Everything stays in your Home Assistant. No cloud, no tracking, nothing goes to the internet. IBANs are deliberately not in any sensor.
<b>📜 Verlauf</b> (⚙️ → Daten): wer hat w:
📜 History log (⚙️ → Data): who changed what and when – checked off, balance, expenses, pots … The last 300 entries, can be switched off, admins can clear it.
👁️ View (⚙️ → View, for everyone): hide sections like pots, income or my accounts. Labels show a short text under the icon buttons. Calm mode (this device only): muted colours, nothing moves. The offline app also has Light / Dark.
🐷 Piggy bank (⚙️ → View → Mascot): sits at the top left and shows how your money is doing – happy in the plus, sceptical just above the warning limit, shocked in the minus. When all fixed costs are checked off, it hops. In the morning it yawns, from 9 pm it sleeps. Tap = back to the overview.
Die Fixkosten sind und bleiben <b>kosten: Fixkosten is and stays free. If you like, you can send me a small donation, completely voluntary. Thank you! 🙏
